analyst_view.overall: AZ (5th, 20 pts) are in a slump. They have lost their last three Eredivisie games, to Feyenoord, Twente and Ajax, and one report has them losing 2-1 at home to Juventus in the Europa League on Thursday. A lineup preview expects rotation. Groningen (8th, 15 pts) are a settled side but come off a late defeat to Sparta, and their league games have been open: 26 scored and 24 conceded in 11.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals. AZ's attack has stalled in the league recently and they have a tired squad after Thursday, which points down. Groningen's games average more than four goals, which points up, so we stay with the model.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.4 corners, most of them expected for AZ. They should still dominate the ball at home, but rotation adds some uncertainty.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards. Jannick van der Laan referees, and we found nothing that points to a more heated game than usual.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.3 shots. AZ under pressure to end a losing run should push forward, but legs may be heavy three days after Juventus.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.3 shots on target. Striker Jizz Hornkamp is listed as an injury doubt, and keeper Jeroen Zoet and Stije Resink are out. Groningen are missing Travis Hernes and Ryan Metu, and one preview adds Mercera to their absentees.
